title: ci: move the agent review to niway-dev/wachiman v1.3.0
body:
## Summary

Points the agent review at **`niway-dev/wachiman` v1.3.0**, the latest release. The engine repository was renamed to `niway-dev/wachiman` (its ADR 0009), and GitHub does not redirect `uses:` after a rename, so the old line fails with "repository not found".

What v1.3.0 brings ([changelog](https://github.com/niway-dev/wachiman/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)):

- every comment the bot posts opens with "👮 **Wachiman**", so it is clear which tool wrote it;
- `/wachiman` is accepted besides `/wachi`;
- the v1.2.1 fixes: engine-only markers, review dating, retries on transient GitHub errors, and review instructions read from the base commit.

## Verification

The PR runs its own `agent-review.yml`; a resolved `uses:` line means the job starts instead of failing at setup.
